independent_unit: Four previously observed whole schools; paired across populations, regimes and species; no actor pseudoreplication
primary: D24 same-H partner effect: (mixed D24 captures - D24-only captures)/(24*36T)
Population interaction: (D24 capture difference - 2*D12 capture difference)/(24*36T)
secondary: D12 same-H partner effect from integer capture difference/(12*36T)
Mixed per-dolphin D24-D12 difference: (mixed D24 captures - 2*mixed D12 captures)/(24*36T)
G_with_D12 and G_with_D24 partner effects from integer mixed-minus-G-only capture differences/(G*36T)
Group capture totals separately from per-animal return; all signs and school points retained
arithmetic: Integer count contrasts before division, exact zeros without epsilon sign thresholds

bootstrap.resampling: One common four-school index matrix across every regime, population and species endpoint
bootstrap.interpretation: Exploratory pointwise intervals, sample SD, sign counts; no multiplicity adjustment or independent validation

selection: Roles A/B chosen by integer D12 captures from all 24 complete upper-map settings before any D24 outcome; no D24-dependent regime or seed selection
controls: New same-H D24-only controls finish before mixed submissions within every phase; completed D12 and count-matched G-only references reused by exact SHA, with no extra independent units
depletion: Actual unique captures divided by fixed nominal36T; effort observed only to complete depletion; no empty-school extrapolation
